# Übersicht

Dieses Dokument integriert klinische Variablen (Demografie, Komorbiditäten, Echo-Parameter, Risiko-Scores) mit den RNA-seq-Daten aus `DEanalysis.qmd`.

**Ziel:** Identifikation klinischer Assoziationen mit molekularen Signaturen (GSVA-Scores) unter Berücksichtigung methodischer Robustheit und Reviewer-Anforderungen.

**Methodische Basis:**
- Schmader et al. 2021 (BMC Cardiovasc Disord): Baseline-Inflammation → TAVR-Outcomes
- Kuppe et al. 2024 (Circ Genom Precis Med): Longitudinale Immunantwort nach MI
- Hänzelmann et al. 2013 (BMC Bioinformatics): GSVA für sample-level Pathway-Scores

**Implementierungsplan:** 12-Schritte-Plan basierend auf CLINICAL_INTEGRATION_REVIEW.md

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup-packages
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Reproduzierbarkeit: Seed setzen
set.seed(42)
message("✓ Seed set to 42 for reproducibility")

# Pakete laden
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readr)
  library(janitor)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)     # Für df-Korrektur bei kleinen n
  library(broom.mixed)
  library(car)          # Für VIF-Berechnung
  library(effectsize)   # Für Cohen's d
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

# Parameter
clinical_params <- list(
  padj_cutoff = 0.05,
  min_n_per_group = 15,    # Minimum n für Interaktionsanalysen
  min_n_subgroup = 20,     # Minimum n für Subgruppenanalysen
  vif_threshold = 5,       # VIF-Schwellenwert für Kollinearität
  seed = 42
)

# Verzeichnisse
clinical_data_dir <- "../../../dat/info_files"
clinical_cache_dir <- "../../../res/cache/clinical"
clinical_output_dir <- "../../../res/clinical"
clinical_fig_dir <- "../../../res/figures/clinical"

dir.create(clinical_cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(clinical_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(clinical_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Cache-Funktion
clinical_cache_key <- function(...) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'digest' required. Install with: install.packages('digest')")
  }
  digest::digest(list(...), algo = "xxhash64")
}

message("✓ Setup complete")
```

# SCHRITT 1: Datenimport & Encodingfix

**Ziel:** Clinical CSV mit korrektem Encoding/Locale importieren, Plausibilitätschecks durchführen

**Kritische Checks:**
- UTF-8/Latin-1 Encoding (prä → pr�)
- Dezimal-Komma (79,73 → 79.73)
- Wertebereich-Validierung

```{r}
#| label: step1-import-clinical
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 1: Clinical Data Import ===")

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_cache <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "clinical_raw.rds")

if (file.exists(clinical_cache)) {
  message("✅ Lade Clinical Cache: ", clinical_cache)
  clinical_raw <- readRDS(clinical_cache)
} else {
  message("⏳ Importiere Clinical CSV...")

  # Import mit korrektem Locale (Dezimal-Komma)
  clinical_raw <- read_delim(
    file.path(clinical_data_dir, "2026-01-03_clinical_data.csv"),
    delim = ";",
    locale = locale(decimal_mark = ",", grouping_mark = "."),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()

  # Encoding-Fix: Falls Umlaute fehlerhaft
  # (Namen mit "pr�" sollten "prä" sein)
  if (any(grepl("pr�", names(clinical_raw)))) {
    names(clinical_raw) <- iconv(names(clinical_raw), from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8")
    message("⚠️ Encoding-Issue detektiert, Namen konvertiert")
  }

  saveRDS(clinical_raw, clinical_cache)
  message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_cache)
}

# ============================================================
# Plausibilitätschecks & Range-Validierung
# ============================================================

# Numerische Variablen-Ranges prüfen
# WICHTIG: Namen nach clean_names() sind lowercase
range_checks <- list(
  age = c(50, 100),
  bmi = c(15, 50),
  pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd = c(10, 120),
  log_euroscore_ii = c(0, 15),
  pr_echo_ef_percent = c(10, 80),
  pr_echo_aoef = c(0.3, 2)
)


for (vname in names(range_checks)) {
  if (vname %in% names(clinical_raw)) {

    val_range <- range(clinical_raw[[vname]], na.rm = TRUE)
    expected  <- range_checks[[vname]]

    if (val_range[1] < expected[1] | val_range[2] > expected[2]) {
      warning(sprintf(
        "⚠️ %s: Range [%.2f, %.2f] außerhalb erwartet [%.0f, %.0f]",
        vname, val_range[1], val_range[2], expected[1], expected[2]
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Extreme Werte identifizieren (für Dokumentation)
# WICHTIG: Spaltennamen nach clean_names() sind lowercase
extreme_cases <- clinical_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    bmi > 40 |
      pr_echo_ef_percent < 20 |
      log_euroscore_ii > 10
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(pid = labor_nr, age, bmi, pr_echo_ef_percent, log_euroscore_ii)

if (nrow(extreme_cases) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ Extreme Werte identifiziert (n=", nrow(extreme_cases), "):")
  print(extreme_cases)
}

# Dimensionen berichten
message("✓ Clinical data imported: ", nrow(clinical_raw), " patients × ",
        ncol(clinical_raw), " variables")
```

---

# SCHRITT 2: Redundanzbereinigung & Variablenerstellung

**Ziel:** Redundante Variablen entfernen, abgeleitete Variablen erstellen

**Aktionen:**
- Entferne: `male` (dupliziert `sex`)
- Nutze: `Labor_Nr` als patientenweite ID (PID) fuer den Join mit RNA-seq
- Erstelle: GFR-Kategorien, BMI-Kategorien, NYHA-Gruppierung, Metabolisches Syndrom

```{r}
#| label: step2-variable-engineering
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 2: Variable Engineering ===")

clinical_clean <- clinical_raw %>%
  # Redundanz entfernen (nach clean_names() sind alle Namen lowercase)
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("male"))) %>%

  # pid fuer Join vorbereiten (Labor_Nr entspricht RNA-seq PID)
  dplyr::rename(pid = labor_nr, clinical_nr = nr) %>%

  # Abgeleitete Variablen
  dplyr::mutate(
    # GFR-Kategorien
    GFR_impaired = ifelse(pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd < 60, "impaired", "normal"),
    GFR_cat = case_when(
      pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd < 30 ~ "severe",
      pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd < 60 ~ "moderate",
      TRUE ~ "normal"
    ),

    # BMI-Kategorien
    BMI_obese = ifelse(bmi >= 30, "obese", "non-obese"),
    BMI_cat = case_when(
      bmi < 25 ~ "normal",
      bmi < 30 ~ "overweight",
      TRUE ~ "obese"
    ),

    # NYHA-Gruppierung (Klasse 4 ist selten, kombiniere 3+4)
    NYHA_grouped = ifelse(nyha_2 >= 3, "NYHA_3-4", "NYHA_2"),

    # Euroscore-Kategorien
    Euroscore_high = ifelse(log_euroscore_ii >= 3, "high", "low"),

    # Metabolisches Syndrom (≥2 aus: Diabetes, Dyslipidämie, Hypertonie, BMI≥30)
    MetS_score = (diabetes == "yes") + (dyslipedemia == "yes") +
                 (hypertension == "yes") + (bmi >= 30),
    MetS = ifelse(MetS_score >= 2, "yes", "no"),

    # Yes/No zu Logical konvertieren (für Modelle)
    across(
      c(atrial_fibrillation_flutter, copd, diabetes, dyslipedemia, hypertension,
        p_avk, cerebrovascular_disease, significant_prior_cad, relevant_cad),
      ~ .x == "yes"
    )
  )

# Faktorisierung
clinical_clean <- clinical_clean %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pid = as.character(pid),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("male", "female")),
    ef_group = factor(ef_group, levels = c("preserved", "reduced")),
    valve_type_grouped = factor(valve_type_grouped, levels = c("BEV", "SEV")),
    GFR_impaired = factor(GFR_impaired, levels = c("normal", "impaired")),
    GFR_cat = factor(GFR_cat, levels = c("normal", "moderate", "severe")),
    BMI_obese = factor(BMI_obese, levels = c("non-obese", "obese")),
    NYHA_grouped = factor(NYHA_grouped, levels = c("NYHA_2", "NYHA_3-4")),
    Euroscore_high = factor(Euroscore_high, levels = c("low", "high")),
    MetS = factor(MetS, levels = c("no", "yes"))
  )

message("✓ Variables engineered: ", ncol(clinical_clean), " columns")
message("  New variables: GFR_impaired, BMI_obese, NYHA_grouped, MetS")
```

---

# SCHRITT 3: Join Clinical → RNA-seq Metadata

**Ziel:** Klinische Daten mit clinical_sample_meta verknüpfen, vollständige QC

**Kritische Checks:**
- Patienten-ID-Matching (Nr ↔ pid)
- Geschlecht/Alter-Abgleich (Validierung)
- Join-Rate dokumentieren

```{r}
#| label: step3-join-metadata
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 3: Join Clinical → RNA-seq Metadata ===")

# ============================================================
# RNA-seq Metadata laden (aus DEanalysis.qmd Cache)
# ============================================================

# WICHTIG: Dieser Chunk setzt voraus, dass DEanalysis.qmd bereits
# gelaufen ist und clinical_sample_meta als RDS gespeichert hat.
# Falls nicht: Erst DEanalysis.qmd bis zur Meta-Erstellung laufen lassen.

deanalysis_cache <- "../../../res/cache/sample_meta_deseq2.rds"

if (!file.exists(deanalysis_cache)) {
  stop(
    "❌ clinical_sample_meta nicht gefunden. Bitte erst DEanalysis.qmd bis Chunk 'deseq2-normalization' laufen lassen.",
    "\n   Erwarteter Pfad: ", deanalysis_cache
  )
}

clinical_sample_meta <- readRDS(deanalysis_cache)
message("✓ Geladen: clinical_sample_meta (n=", nrow(clinical_sample_meta), " samples)")

# ============================================================
# PRE-JOIN DIAGNOSTIK
# ============================================================

# Unique PIDs in beiden Datasets
pids_clinical <- unique(clinical_clean$pid)
pids_rnaseq <- unique(clinical_sample_meta$pid)

n_clinical <- length(pids_clinical)
n_rnaseq <- length(pids_rnaseq)

# Matching-Statistik
pids_both <- intersect(pids_clinical, pids_rnaseq)
pids_clinical_only <- setdiff(pids_clinical, pids_rnaseq)
pids_rnaseq_only <- setdiff(pids_rnaseq, pids_clinical)

message("\n--- PRE-JOIN DIAGNOSTIK ---")
message("Clinical patients: ", n_clinical)
message("RNA-seq patients: ", n_rnaseq)
message("Matched: ", length(pids_both), " (",
        round(length(pids_both)/n_rnaseq*100, 1), "% of RNA-seq)")
message("Clinical-only: ", length(pids_clinical_only))
message("RNA-seq-only: ", length(pids_rnaseq_only))

if (length(pids_clinical_only) > 0) {
  message("→ Unmatched Clinical PIDs: ", paste(pids_clinical_only, collapse = ", "))
}

if (length(pids_rnaseq_only) > 0) {
  message("→ Unmatched RNA-seq PIDs: ", paste(pids_rnaseq_only, collapse = ", "))
}

# ============================================================
# JOIN (left_join auf clinical_sample_meta)
# ============================================================

sample_meta_clinical <- clinical_sample_meta %>%
  left_join(clinical_clean, by = "pid", suffix = c("_rnaseq", "_clinical"))

# Validierung: Row count muss identisch sein (kein Expansion)
stopifnot(nrow(sample_meta_clinical) == nrow(clinical_sample_meta))

# ============================================================
# POST-JOIN VALIDIERUNG
# ============================================================

# Anteil gemappter Samples
n_mapped <- sum(!is.na(sample_meta_clinical$age))
join_rate <- n_mapped / nrow(sample_meta_clinical)

message("\n--- POST-JOIN DIAGNOSTIK ---")
message("Total samples: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical))
message("Mapped samples: ", n_mapped, " (", round(join_rate*100, 1), "%)")
message("Unmapped samples: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical) - n_mapped)

# CRITICAL CHECK: Join-Rate sollte >90% sein
if (join_rate < 0.9) {
  warning("⚠️ Join-Rate < 90% — prüfe Patienten-ID-Kodierung!")
}

# ============================================================
# GESCHLECHT-ABGLEICH (Cross-Validation)
# ============================================================

# Falls Geschlecht in beiden Tabellen vorhanden: Abgleichen
if ("sex_rnaseq" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical) &&
    "sex_clinical" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical)) {

  sex_mismatch <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(sex_clinical)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(sex_rnaseq != sex_clinical)

  if (nrow(sex_mismatch) > 0) {
    warning("⚠️ Geschlechts-Mismatch bei ", nrow(sex_mismatch), " Samples!")
    print(sex_mismatch %>% select(sample_id, pid, sex_rnaseq, sex_clinical))
  } else {
    message("✓ Geschlecht: Alle Samples konsistent")
  }
}

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================

saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical.rds"))
message("💾 Gespeichert: sample_meta_clinical.rds")
```

---

# SCHRITT 4: Dropout-Analyse

**Ziel:** Dokumentiere n pro Zeitpunkt, teste MCAR-Annahme

**Stop-Regel:** Wenn >30% Dropout → Analysestrategie reassessieren

```{r}
#| label: step4-dropout-analysis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 4: Dropout-Analyse ===")

# ============================================================
# N pro Zeitpunkt
# ============================================================

n_per_timepoint <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_with_clinical = sum(!is.na(age)),
    pct_clinical = round(n_with_clinical / n_total * 100, 1)
  )

print(n_per_timepoint)

# ============================================================
# Komplette Triplets (Patienten mit allen 3 Zeitpunkten)
# ============================================================

triplet_status <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  group_by(pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_timepoints = n(),
    has_A = any(timepoint == "A"),
    has_V1 = any(timepoint == "V1"),
    has_V2 = any(timepoint == "V2"),
    complete_triplet = n_timepoints == 3 & has_A & has_V1 & has_V2
  )

n_complete <- sum(triplet_status$complete_triplet)
n_total_patients <- nrow(triplet_status)
dropout_rate <- 1 - (n_complete / n_total_patients)

message("\n--- TRIPLET COMPLETENESS ---")
message("Total patients: ", n_total_patients)
message("Complete triplets (A + V1 + V2): ", n_complete)
message("Dropout rate: ", round(dropout_rate * 100, 1), "%")

# STOP-REGEL: >30% Dropout
if (dropout_rate > 0.3) {
  warning(
    "⚠️ STOP-REGEL AUSGELÖST: Dropout rate > 30%!\n",
    "   → Analysestrategie muss angepasst werden (mixed models statt complete-case)\n",
    "   → Oder: Dropout-Charakteristika analysieren (MCAR vs MAR?)"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Dropout-Charakteristika (falls Dropout > 10%)
# ============================================================

if (dropout_rate > 0.1) {
  message("\n--- DROPOUT CHARACTERISTICS ---")

  dropout_comparison <- clinical_clean %>%
    mutate(
      has_complete_triplet = pid %in% triplet_status$pid[triplet_status$complete_triplet]
    ) %>%
    group_by(has_complete_triplet) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      age_mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      euroscore_mean = mean(log_euroscore_ii, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_female = mean(sex == "female", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      pct_reduced_EF = mean(ef_group == "reduced", na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    )

  print(dropout_comparison)

  # Test auf MCAR (Chi-Quadrat für kategoriale Variablen)
  # Falls signifikant → MAR oder MNAR, nicht MCAR
}

# ============================================================
# Complete-Case Dataset für Primary Analyses
# ============================================================

sample_meta_clinical_complete <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(pid %in% triplet_status$pid[triplet_status$complete_triplet]) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(age))  # Alle mit klinischen Daten

message("\n✓ Complete-case dataset: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical_complete),
        " samples from ", n_distinct(sample_meta_clinical_complete$pid), " patients")

saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical_complete,
        file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical_complete.rds"))
```

---

# SCHRITT 5: Cell-type Deconvolution (Optional)

**Ziel:** Schätze Zelltyp-Proportionen, prüfe Plausibilität

**Methode:** CIBERSORTx oder MCP-counter (hier: Placeholder für Integration)

**Entscheidung:** Als Covariate adjustieren ODER als Limitation dokumentieren

```{r}
#| label: step5-deconvolution
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 5: Cell-type Deconvolution ===")

# ============================================================
# Ziel: Schätze Zelltyp-Proportionen mit MCP-counter
# Methode: immunedeconv (signature-based, keine Referenz nötig)
# Literatur: Becht et al. 2016 (Genome Biol), Kuppe et al. 2024
# ============================================================

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_deconv_cache <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "deconvolution_mcp.rds")

if (file.exists(clinical_deconv_cache)) {
  message("✅ Lade Deconvolution Cache: ", clinical_deconv_cache)
  clinical_deconv_results <- readRDS(clinical_deconv_cache)
} else {
  message("⏳ Führe Cell-type Deconvolution durch (MCP-counter)...")

  # Prüfe ob immunedeconv verfügbar ist
  if (!requireNamespace("immunedeconv", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("⚠️ Paket 'immunedeconv' nicht installiert.")
    message("   Installation: devtools::install_github('omnideconv/immunedeconv')")
    message("   → Überspringe Deconvolution (wird als Limitation dokumentiert)")

    # Leere Placeholder-Matrix
    clinical_deconv_results <- NULL

  } else {
    # VST-Daten aus DEanalysis.qmd laden
    deanalysis_vst_cache <- "../../../res/cache/vst_matrix.rds"

    if (!file.exists(deanalysis_vst_cache)) {
      stop(
        "❌ VST-Matrix nicht gefunden. Bitte erst DEanalysis.qmd bis 'qc-vst-pca' laufen lassen.",
        "\n   Erwarteter Pfad: ", deanalysis_vst_cache
      )
    }

    clinical_vst_matrix <- readRDS(deanalysis_vst_cache)
    message("✓ VST-Matrix geladen: ", nrow(clinical_vst_matrix), " genes × ",
            ncol(clinical_vst_matrix), " samples")

    # MCP-counter Deconvolution
    # WICHTIG: MCP-counter erwartet Gene-Symbole, nicht ENSEMBL-IDs
    # Falls VST-Matrix ENSEMBL-IDs hat: Gene-Annotation laden
    if (all(grepl("^ENSG", rownames(clinical_vst_matrix)[1:10]))) {
      message("→ VST-Matrix hat ENSEMBL-IDs, konvertiere zu Gene-Symbolen...")

      # Annotation aus DEanalysis.qmd laden
      gene_anno_cache <- "../../../res/cache/gene_annotation.rds"
      if (file.exists(gene_anno_cache)) {
        clinical_gene_anno <- readRDS(gene_anno_cache)

        # Strip Version von ENSEMBL-IDs falls nötig
        clinical_vst_ensembl <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(clinical_vst_matrix))
        clinical_gene_anno$ensembl_id <- sub("\\..*", "", clinical_gene_anno$ensembl_id)

        # Mapping ENSEMBL → SYMBOL
        idx <- match(clinical_vst_ensembl, clinical_gene_anno$ensembl_id)
        clinical_vst_symbols <- clinical_gene_anno$SYMBOL[idx]

        # Entferne NAs und Duplikate (nehme ersten)
        valid <- !is.na(clinical_vst_symbols) & clinical_vst_symbols != ""
        clinical_vst_matrix_symbols <- clinical_vst_matrix[valid, ]
        rownames(clinical_vst_matrix_symbols) <- clinical_vst_symbols[valid]

        # Bei duplizierten Symbolen: Mittelwert
        clinical_vst_matrix_symbols <- clinical_vst_matrix_symbols[
          !duplicated(rownames(clinical_vst_matrix_symbols)),
        ]

        message("✓ Konvertierung: ", nrow(clinical_vst_matrix), " → ",
                nrow(clinical_vst_matrix_symbols), " genes mit Symbolen")

        clinical_vst_matrix <- clinical_vst_matrix_symbols
      } else {
        stop("❌ Gene-Annotation nicht gefunden: ", gene_anno_cache)
      }
    }

    # MCP-counter ausführen
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(immunedeconv))

    clinical_deconv_mcp <- immunedeconv::deconvolute(
      gene_expression = clinical_vst_matrix,
      method = "mcp_counter"
    )

    # Formatierung: Long → Wide (Samples × Cell Types)
    clinical_deconv_results <- clinical_deconv_mcp %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = -cell_type,
        names_to = "sample_id",
        values_to = "mcp_score"
      ) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = cell_type,
        values_from = mcp_score,
        names_prefix = "celltype_"
      )

    # Speichere Cache
    saveRDS(clinical_deconv_results, clinical_deconv_cache)
    message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_deconv_cache)
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Merge mit sample_meta_clinical
# ============================================================

if (!is.null(clinical_deconv_results)) {

  # Vor Merge: Anzahl
  n_before <- nrow(sample_meta_clinical)

  sample_meta_clinical <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    left_join(clinical_deconv_results, by = "sample_id")

  # Validierung: Kein Row-Expansion
  stopifnot(nrow(sample_meta_clinical) == n_before)

  # Anzahl gemappter Samples
  n_with_deconv <- sum(!is.na(sample_meta_clinical$celltype_T_cells))
  message("✓ Deconvolution-Scores hinzugefügt: ", n_with_deconv, " / ",
          n_before, " samples (", round(n_with_deconv/n_before*100, 1), "%)")

  # Plausibilitätsprüfung: Monozyten sollten in V1 höher sein als A
  # (basierend auf Kuppe et al. 2024 - STEMI-Studie)
  if ("celltype_Monocytes" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical)) {
    clinical_mono_check <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
      filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1"), !is.na(celltype_Monocytes)) %>%
      group_by(timepoint) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_mono = mean(celltype_Monocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_mono = sd(celltype_Monocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    message("\n--- PLAUSIBILITÄTSPRÜFUNG: Monozyten ---")
    print(clinical_mono_check)

    mono_V1 <- clinical_mono_check$mean_mono[clinical_mono_check$timepoint == "V1"]
    mono_A <- clinical_mono_check$mean_mono[clinical_mono_check$timepoint == "A"]

    if (mono_V1 > mono_A) {
      message("✓ Monozyten: V1 > A (erwartet nach Kuppe 2024)")
    } else {
      message("⚠️ Monozyten: V1 ≤ A (unerwartet, prüfe Methodik)")
    }
  }

  # Update Complete-Case Dataset
  sample_meta_clinical_complete <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    filter(pid %in% unique(sample_meta_clinical$pid[
      !is.na(sample_meta_clinical$age)
    ]))

  saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical_complete,
          file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical_complete.rds"))

} else {
  message("⚠️ Deconvolution nicht durchgeführt → wird als Limitation dokumentiert")
  message("   Begründung: immunedeconv nicht installiert oder VST-Daten fehlen")
}
```

# SCHRITT 6: Pathway-Definition & GSVA-Berechnung

**Ziel:** A-priori Pathway-Sets definieren, GSVA-Scores berechnen

**Pathway-Gruppen:**
1. Inflammation: HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE, GO_INNATE_IMMUNE_RESPONSE
2. Ribosome: KEGG_RIBOSOME, HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1, GO_TRANSLATIONAL_INITIATION
3. Adaptive Immunity: GO_T_CELL_ACTIVATION, GO_B_CELL_MEDIATED_IMMUNITY, HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING

```{r}
#| label: step6-gsva-pathways
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 6: GSVA Pathway-Scores ===")

# ============================================================
# Ziel: Lade GSVA-Scores aus DEanalysis.qmd, selektiere A-priori Pathways
# A-priori Basis: Schmader et al. 2021, Kuppe et al. 2024, RESULTS_STORY.md
# Literatur: Hänzelmann et al. 2013 (GSVA original)
# ============================================================

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_gsva_composite_cache <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "gsva_composite_scores.rds")

if (file.exists(clinical_gsva_composite_cache)) {
  message("✅ Lade GSVA Composite Cache: ", clinical_gsva_composite_cache)
  clinical_gsva_composite <- readRDS(clinical_gsva_composite_cache)

} else {
  message("⏳ Berechne GSVA Composite-Scores...")

  # ============================================================
  # GSVA-Cache aus DEanalysis.qmd laden
  # ============================================================

  clinical_gsva_cache_path <- "../../../res/cache/gsva_hallmark_scores.rds"

  if (!file.exists(clinical_gsva_cache_path)) {
    stop(
      "❌ GSVA-Cache nicht gefunden.",
      "\n   Erwarteter Pfad: ", clinical_gsva_cache_path,
      "\n   Bitte erst DEanalysis.qmd Chunk 'gsva-hallmark' ausführen."
    )
  }

  clinical_gsva_scores <- readRDS(clinical_gsva_cache_path)
  message("✓ GSVA-Scores geladen: ", nrow(clinical_gsva_scores), " pathways × ",
          ncol(clinical_gsva_scores), " samples")

  # ============================================================
  # A-priori Pathway-Selektion (literatur-basiert)
  # ============================================================

  # Pathway-Definition basierend auf:
  # 1. RESULTS_STORY.md: Biphasische Ribosomen-Signatur, Inflammation, Adaptive Immunity
  # 2. Schmader 2021: Inflammation + Interferon als Composite
  # 3. Kuppe 2024: Myeloid-Lymphoid-Shift

  clinical_pathways_apriori <- list(
    inflammation = c(
      "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",
      "HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING"
    ),
    ribosome = c(
      "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1",        # Ribosomale Biogenese
      "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION"  # Energiestoffwechsel
    ),
    adaptive = c(
      "HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION"    # T-Zell-Aktivierung
    ),
    interferon = c(
      "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE"
    )
  )

  # Prüfe, welche Pathways verfügbar sind
  clinical_available_pathways <- rownames(clinical_gsva_scores)
  clinical_missing_pathways <- setdiff(
    unlist(clinical_pathways_apriori),
    clinical_available_pathways
  )

  if (length(clinical_missing_pathways) > 0) {
    message("⚠️ Fehlende Pathways in GSVA-Ergebnissen:")
    for (pw in clinical_missing_pathways) {
      message("  - ", pw)
    }
    message("   → Composite-Scores basieren nur auf verfügbaren Pathways")
  }

  # Dokumentiere verwendete Pathways
  clinical_pathways_used <- lapply(clinical_pathways_apriori, function(pws) {
    intersect(pws, clinical_available_pathways)
  })

  message("\n--- VERWENDETE PATHWAYS PRO GRUPPE ---")
  for (group_name in names(clinical_pathways_used)) {
    message(sprintf("  %s (%d pathways):", group_name, length(clinical_pathways_used[[group_name]])))
    for (pw in clinical_pathways_used[[group_name]]) {
      message("    - ", pw)
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Composite-Scores (Mittelwert pro Gruppe)
  # ============================================================

  # Sichere Mittelwert-Funktion (handhabt fehlende Pathways)
  clinical_safe_colmeans <- function(gsva_mat, pathways) {
    present <- intersect(pathways, rownames(gsva_mat))
    if (length(present) == 0) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(gsva_mat)))
    }
    if (length(present) == 1) {
      return(gsva_mat[present, ])
    }
    colMeans(gsva_mat[present, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  clinical_gsva_composite <- data.frame(
    sample_id = colnames(clinical_gsva_scores),
    clinical_inflammation_score = clinical_safe_colmeans(
      clinical_gsva_scores,
      clinical_pathways_used$inflammation
    ),
    clinical_ribosome_score = clinical_safe_colmeans(
      clinical_gsva_scores,
      clinical_pathways_used$ribosome
    ),
    clinical_adaptive_score = clinical_safe_colmeans(
      clinical_gsva_scores,
      clinical_pathways_used$adaptive
    ),
    clinical_interferon_score = clinical_safe_colmeans(
      clinical_gsva_scores,
      clinical_pathways_used$interferon
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Range-Validierung
  clinical_score_ranges <- clinical_gsva_composite %>%
    select(-sample_id) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
      max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE),
      mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
      na_count = ~sum(is.na(.))
    )))

  message("\n--- COMPOSITE-SCORE RANGES ---")
  print(clinical_score_ranges)

  # Warnung bei zu vielen NAs
  na_threshold <- 0.1
  for (col in names(clinical_gsva_composite)[-1]) {
    na_pct <- mean(is.na(clinical_gsva_composite[[col]]))
    if (na_pct > na_threshold) {
      warning(sprintf("⚠️ %s: %.1f%% NAs (Schwelle: %.0f%%)",
                      col, na_pct * 100, na_threshold * 100))
    }
  }

  # Speichere Cache
  saveRDS(clinical_gsva_composite, clinical_gsva_composite_cache)
  message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_gsva_composite_cache)
}

# ============================================================
# Merge mit sample_meta_clinical
# ============================================================

n_before <- nrow(sample_meta_clinical)

sample_meta_clinical <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  left_join(clinical_gsva_composite, by = "sample_id")

# Validierung
stopifnot(nrow(sample_meta_clinical) == n_before)

n_with_gsva <- sum(!is.na(sample_meta_clinical$clinical_inflammation_score))
message("✓ GSVA composite scores hinzugefügt: ", n_with_gsva, " / ", n_before,
        " samples (", round(n_with_gsva/n_before*100, 1), "%)")

# Update Complete-Case
sample_meta_clinical_complete <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score))

message("✓ Complete-case dataset: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical_complete),
        " samples from ", n_distinct(sample_meta_clinical_complete$pid), " patients")

saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical_gsva.rds"))
saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical_complete,
        file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical_complete.rds"))
```

# SCHRITT 7: Delta-Variablen

**Ziel:** Patient-level Deltas für V1-A, V2-V1, V2-A berechnen

```{r}
#| label: step7-delta-variables
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 7: Delta-Variablen ===")

# ============================================================
# Ziel: Patient-level Deltas für V1-A, V2-V1, V2-A berechnen
# Verwendung: Für Patient-level Analysen (Alternative zu mixed models)
# Entscheidung E3: Beide Ansätze (Delta als Sensitivity)
# ============================================================

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_delta_cache <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "delta_data_clinical.rds")

if (file.exists(clinical_delta_cache)) {
  message("✅ Lade Delta Cache: ", clinical_delta_cache)
  clinical_delta_data <- readRDS(clinical_delta_cache)

} else {
  message("⏳ Berechne Delta-Variablen...")

  # ============================================================
  # Delta-Berechnung (pro Patient, pro Pathway)
  # ============================================================

  # Selektiere relevante Spalten
  clinical_delta_long <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
    select(
      pid, timepoint,
      clinical_inflammation_score,
      clinical_ribosome_score,
      clinical_adaptive_score,
      clinical_interferon_score
    )

  # Pivot zu Wide (ein Patient pro Zeile, Zeitpunkte als Spalten)
  clinical_delta_wide <- clinical_delta_long %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = pid,
      names_from = timepoint,
      values_from = c(
        clinical_inflammation_score,
        clinical_ribosome_score,
        clinical_adaptive_score,
        clinical_interferon_score
      )
    )

  # Delta-Berechnung
  clinical_delta_data <- clinical_delta_wide %>%
    mutate(
      # Inflammation Deltas
      clinical_delta_inflammation_V1_A = clinical_inflammation_score_V1 - clinical_inflammation_score_A,
      clinical_delta_inflammation_V2_V1 = clinical_inflammation_score_V2 - clinical_inflammation_score_V1,
      clinical_delta_inflammation_V2_A = clinical_inflammation_score_V2 - clinical_inflammation_score_A,

      # Ribosome Deltas
      clinical_delta_ribosome_V1_A = clinical_ribosome_score_V1 - clinical_ribosome_score_A,
      clinical_delta_ribosome_V2_V1 = clinical_ribosome_score_V2 - clinical_ribosome_score_V1,
      clinical_delta_ribosome_V2_A = clinical_ribosome_score_V2 - clinical_ribosome_score_A,

      # Adaptive Deltas
      clinical_delta_adaptive_V1_A = clinical_adaptive_score_V1 - clinical_adaptive_score_A,
      clinical_delta_adaptive_V2_V1 = clinical_adaptive_score_V2 - clinical_adaptive_score_V1,
      clinical_delta_adaptive_V2_A = clinical_adaptive_score_V2 - clinical_adaptive_score_A,

      # Interferon Deltas
      clinical_delta_interferon_V1_A = clinical_interferon_score_V1 - clinical_interferon_score_A,
      clinical_delta_interferon_V2_V1 = clinical_interferon_score_V2 - clinical_interferon_score_V1,
      clinical_delta_interferon_V2_A = clinical_interferon_score_V2 - clinical_interferon_score_A
    )

  # Merge mit klinischen Baseline-Daten (patient-level)
  clinical_delta_data <- clinical_delta_data %>%
    left_join(clinical_clean, by = "pid")

  # Validierung: Anzahl Patienten
  n_patients_delta <- nrow(clinical_delta_data)
  n_expected <- n_distinct(sample_meta_clinical$pid[
    !is.na(sample_meta_clinical$age) &
      !is.na(sample_meta_clinical$clinical_inflammation_score)
  ])

  message(sprintf("✓ Delta variables calculated for %d patients (erwartet: %d)",
                  n_patients_delta, n_expected))

  # Prüfe auf fehlende Werte
  clinical_delta_completeness <- clinical_delta_data %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_complete_V1_A = sum(!is.na(clinical_delta_inflammation_V1_A)),
      n_complete_V2_V1 = sum(!is.na(clinical_delta_inflammation_V2_V1)),
      n_complete_V2_A = sum(!is.na(clinical_delta_inflammation_V2_A))
    )

  message("\n--- DELTA COMPLETENESS ---")
  print(clinical_delta_completeness)

  if (clinical_delta_completeness$n_complete_V1_A < n_patients_delta * 0.9) {
    warning("⚠️ >10% fehlende Deltas V1-A — prüfe Dropout-Pattern")
  }

  # Range-Validierung (Deltas sollten sinnvoll sein)
  clinical_delta_ranges <- clinical_delta_data %>%
    select(starts_with("clinical_delta_")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
      max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE),
      mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)
    )))

  message("\n--- DELTA RANGES (INFLAMMATION) ---")
  clinical_delta_ranges %>%
    select(contains("inflammation")) %>%
    print()

  # Speichere Cache
  saveRDS(clinical_delta_data, clinical_delta_cache)
  message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_delta_cache)
}

message("✓ Delta-Daten verfügbar für patient-level Analysen")
```

message("=== SCHRITT 8: Table 1 — Clinical Characteristics ===")

# ============================================================
# Ziel: STROBE-konforme Table 1 mit Zellenbesetzung-Dokumentation

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_table1_cache <- file.path(clinical_output_dir, "table1_clinical_characteristics.csv")

# ============================================================
# Helper-Funktionen für deskriptive Statistik
# ============================================================

# Kontinuierliche Variablen: Mean ± SD
clinical_describe_continuous <- function(data, var_name) {
  vec <- data[[var_name]]
  n_obs <- sum(!is.na(vec))
  if (n_obs == 0) {
    return(sprintf("N=0"))
  }
  m <- mean(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- sd(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f (n=%d)", m, s, n_obs)
}

# Kategoriale Variablen: n (%)
clinical_describe_categorical <- function(data, var_name, level = NULL) {
  vec <- data[[var_name]]
  n_total <- sum(!is.na(vec))
  if (n_total == 0) {
    return(sprintf("0 (0%%)"))
  }
  if (is.null(level)) {
    # Falls kein Level: nimm erstes non-NA unique
    level <- unique(vec)[!is.na(unique(vec))][1]
  }
  n_level <- sum(vec == level, na.rm = TRUE)
  pct <- round(n_level / n_total * 100, 1)
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_level, pct)
}

# ============================================================
# OVERALL Statistik (alle Patienten)
# ============================================================

message("⏳ Berechne Overall-Statistik...")

clinical_table1_overall <- clinical_clean %>%
  summarise(
    Group = "Overall",

    # Demographics

    BMI = clinical_describe_continuous(., "bmi"),

    # Echo
    EF_percent = clinical_describe_continuous(., "pr_echo_ef_percent"),
    EF_reduced = clinical_describe_categorical(., "ef_group", "reduced"),

    # Comorbidities
    Diabetes = clinical_describe_categorical(., "diabetes", TRUE),
    Hypertension = clinical_describe_categorical(., "hypertension", TRUE),
    Dyslipidemia = clinical_describe_categorical(., "dyslipedemia", TRUE),
    Atrial_Fib = clinical_describe_categorical(., "atrial_fibrillation_flutter", TRUE),
    CAD = clinical_describe_categorical(., "relevant_cad", TRUE),
    COPD = clinical_describe_categorical(., "copd", TRUE),

    # Lab
    GFR_MDRD = clinical_describe_continuous(., "pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd"),
    GFR_impaired = clinical_describe_categorical(., "GFR_impaired", "impaired"),

    # Valve
    Valve_SEV = clinical_describe_categorical(., "valve_type_grouped", "SEV")
  )

# ============================================================
# STRATIFIZIERT nach EF_group
# ============================================================

message("⏳ Stratifiziere nach EF_group...")

clinical_table1_ef <- clinical_clean %>%
  group_by(ef_group) %>%
  summarise(
    Group = paste0("EF_", cur_group_id()),

    EF_percent = clinical_describe_continuous(cur_data(), "pr_echo_ef_percent"),
    EF_reduced = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "ef_group", "reduced"),
    Diabetes = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "diabetes", TRUE),
    Hypertension = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "hypertension", TRUE),
    Dyslipidemia = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "dyslipedemia", TRUE),
    Atrial_Fib = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "atrial_fibrillation_flutter", TRUE),
    CAD = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "relevant_cad", TRUE),
    COPD = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "copd", TRUE),
    GFR_MDRD = clinical_describe_continuous(cur_data(), "pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd"),
    GFR_impaired = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "GFR_impaired", "impaired"),
    Valve_SEV = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "valve_type_grouped", "SEV"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

# ============================================================

# ============================================================

clinical_table1_cad <- clinical_clean %>%

    Euroscore_II = clinical_describe_continuous(cur_data(), "log_euroscore_ii"),
    NYHA_3_4 = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "NYHA_grouped", "NYHA_3-4"),
    EF_percent = clinical_describe_continuous(cur_data(), "pr_echo_ef_percent"),
    EF_reduced = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "ef_group", "reduced"),
    Diabetes = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "diabetes", TRUE),
    Hypertension = clinical_describe_categorical(cur_data(), "hypertension", TRUE),

# SCHRITT 9: Primary Analyses

**Ziel:** 3 Primary Research Questions mit vollständiger Dokumentation

**Analysen:**
1. Q1: EF_group × Inflammation (V1 vs A)
2. Q2: Relevant_CAD × Ribosome Recovery (V2 vs V1)
3. LQ2: Myeloid-Lymphoid-Shift

**Methode:** Linear Mixed Models (`lmerTest::lmer`)

**Pflicht-Checks:**
- VIF < 5
- Residuen-Diagnostik
- Zellenbesetzung (n≥15 pro Interaktionszelle)

```{r}
#| label: step9-primary-q1-ef-inflammation
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.width: 10
#| fig.height: 8

message("=== SCHRITT 9.1: PRIMARY Q1 — EF_group × Inflammation ===")

# ============================================================
# Research Question Q1 (PRIMARY):
# Patienten mit reduzierter EF zeigen stärkere/veränderte akute
# Inflammationsantwort (V1 vs A) im Vergleich zu erhaltener EF
#
# Literatur-Basis: HFrEF = systemische Inflammation (Granger 2005)
# Hypothese: EF-Gruppe moduliert Inflammations-Dynamik post-TAVI
# ============================================================

# Daten: Nur A + V1, nur Patienten mit EF_group und vollständigen Daten
clinical_data_q1 <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ef_group), !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
  droplevels()

message("✓ Q1 Dataset: ", nrow(clinical_data_q1), " samples from ",
        n_distinct(clinical_data_q1$pid), " patients")

# ============================================================
# PRE-ANALYSIS: Zellenbesetzung (KRITISCH)
# ============================================================

clinical_cell_counts_q1 <- clinical_data_q1 %>%
  count(timepoint, ef_group) %>%
  arrange(timepoint, ef_group)

message("\n--- ZELLENBESETZUNG Q1 ---")
print(clinical_cell_counts_q1)

clinical_min_cell_q1 <- min(clinical_cell_counts_q1$n)

if (clinical_min_cell_q1 < clinical_params$min_n_per_group) {
  warning(sprintf(
    "⚠️ STOP-REGEL: Minimale Zelle (%d) < Schwelle (%d)",
    clinical_min_cell_q1, clinical_params$min_n_per_group
  ))
  message("   → Interaktion timepoint × ef_group NICHT empfohlen")
  message("   → Analysiere nur Haupteffekte")
  clinical_q1_run_interaction <- FALSE
} else {
  message("✓ Zellenbesetzung ausreichend für Interaktionsmodell")
  clinical_q1_run_interaction <- TRUE
}

# ============================================================
# MODELL: Mixed-Effects mit Interaktion
# ============================================================

if (clinical_q1_run_interaction) {
  message("\n⏳ Fitte Interaktionsmodell...")

  clinical_model_q1 <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * ef_group + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_q1,
    REML = TRUE
  )

} else {
  message("\n⏳ Fitte Haupteffekt-Modell (ohne Interaktion)...")

  clinical_model_q1 <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + ef_group + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_q1,
    REML = TRUE
  )
}

# Summary
message("\n--- MODEL SUMMARY Q1 ---")
print(summary(clinical_model_q1))

# ============================================================
# VIF-Check (Kollinearität)
# ============================================================

message("\n--- VIF CHECK Q1 ---")
clinical_vif_q1 <- car::vif(clinical_model_q1)
print(clinical_vif_q1)

if (any(clinical_vif_q1 > clinical_params$vif_threshold)) {
  warning(sprintf(
    "⚠️ VIF > %.1f detektiert — Kollinearität vorhanden!",
    clinical_params$vif_threshold
  ))
  message("   Betroffene Variablen:")
  print(clinical_vif_q1[clinical_vif_q1 > clinical_params$vif_threshold])
} else {
  message("✓ VIF < ", clinical_params$vif_threshold, " — keine Kollinearität")
}

# ============================================================
# Koeffizienten-Extraktion
# ============================================================

clinical_coef_q1 <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_q1, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
  select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

message("\n--- COEFFICIENTS Q1 ---")
print(clinical_coef_q1, n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# Residuen-Diagnostik
# ============================================================

clinical_data_q1$residuals <- residuals(clinical_model_q1)
clinical_data_q1$fitted <- fitted(clinical_model_q1)

# Plot: Residuals vs Fitted + Q-Q
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Residuals vs Fitted
plot(
  clinical_data_q1$fitted,
  clinical_data_q1$residuals,
  xlab = "Fitted Values",
  ylab = "Residuals",
  main = "Q1: Residuals vs Fitted",
  pch = 16,
  col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
)
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2)
loess_fit <- loess(residuals ~ fitted, data = clinical_data_q1)
lines(sort(clinical_data_q1$fitted), predict(loess_fit)[order(clinical_data_q1$fitted)],
      col = "blue", lwd = 2)

# Q-Q Plot
qqnorm(clinical_data_q1$residuals, main = "Q1: Normal Q-Q Plot", pch = 16)
qqline(clinical_data_q1$residuals, col = "red", lwd = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ============================================================
# Effect Size: Cohen's d (pro Gruppe)
# ============================================================

message("\n--- EFFECT SIZES Q1 ---")

clinical_effect_q1 <- clinical_data_q1 %>%
  group_by(timepoint, ef_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(clinical_inflammation_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(clinical_inflammation_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(clinical_effect_q1)

# Cohen's d für V1-A Delta pro EF-Gruppe
clinical_data_q1_wide <- clinical_data_q1 %>%
  select(pid, timepoint, ef_group, clinical_inflammation_score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = clinical_inflammation_score) %>%
  mutate(delta_V1_A = V1 - A)

clinical_cohens_d_q1 <- clinical_data_q1_wide %>%
  group_by(ef_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_delta = mean(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_delta = sd(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cohens_d = mean_delta / sd_delta
  )

message("\nCohen's d für V1-A Delta (pro EF-Gruppe):")
print(clinical_cohens_d_q1)

# ============================================================
# Visualisierung: Interaction Plot
# ============================================================

clinical_plot_q1 <- clinical_effect_q1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = mean, color = ef_group, group = ef_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PRIMARY Q1: EF Group × Inflammation Response",
    subtitle = sprintf("Interaction Model (n=%d patients)", n_distinct(clinical_data_q1$pid)),
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Inflammation Score (GSVA Composite)",
    color = "EF Group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(clinical_plot_q1)

# Speichere Figure
ggsave(
  file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_q1_ef_inflammation.png"),
  clinical_plot_q1,
  width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

message("💾 Figure gespeichert: primary_q1_ef_inflammation.png")

# ============================================================
# Speichere Ergebnisse
# ============================================================

clinical_results_q1 <- list(
  model = clinical_model_q1,
  coefficients = clinical_coef_q1,
  vif = clinical_vif_q1,
  effect_sizes = clinical_effect_q1,
  cohens_d = clinical_cohens_d_q1,
  cell_counts = clinical_cell_counts_q1,
  plot = clinical_plot_q1
)

saveRDS(clinical_results_q1, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "primary_q1_results.rds"))
message("💾 Ergebnisse gespeichert: primary_q1_results.rds")

message("\n✓ PRIMARY Q1 abgeschlossen")
```

```{r}
#| label: step9-primary-lq2-myeloid-lymphoid-shift
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 10

message("=== SCHRITT 9.3: PRIMARY LQ2 — Myeloid-Lymphoid-Shift ===")

# ============================================================
# Research Question LQ2 (PRIMARY):
# TAVI induziert biphasische Myeloid-Lymphoid-Dynamik:
# - V1 (akut): Myeloid ↑, Lymphoid ↓
# - V2 (Recovery): Rebalancierung / Reversion
#
# Literatur-Basis: Kuppe et al. 2024 (STEMI scRNA-seq)
# - Monozyten ↑, NK-Zellen ↓ in akuter Phase
# - Lymphoid Recovery nach Wochen
# Novelty: Erste Anwendung auf TAVI-Kohorte (Bulk RNA-seq)
# ============================================================

message("\n⏳ Prüfe Deconvolution-Verfügbarkeit...")

# Prüfe ob Deconvolution-Scores verfügbar sind
clinical_has_deconv <- "celltype_Monocytes" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical_complete)

if (!clinical_has_deconv) {
  message("⚠️ Deconvolution-Scores NICHT verfügbar")
  message("   → LQ2 wird mit Pathway-basierten Surrogaten analysiert")
  message("   → Limitation: Keine direkte Zelltyp-Quantifikation")

  # Alternative: Pathway-basierte Zelltyp-Signaturen
  # (Falls GSVA mit GO-Terms verfügbar)
  clinical_lq2_mode <- "pathway"

} else {
  message("✓ Deconvolution-Scores verfügbar (MCP-counter)")
  message("   → LQ2 wird mit direkten Zelltyp-Scores analysiert")
  clinical_lq2_mode <- "deconvolution"
}

# ============================================================
# MODUS 1: Deconvolution-basiert (bevorzugt)
# ============================================================

if (clinical_lq2_mode == "deconvolution") {

  # Daten: Alle 3 Zeitpunkte
  clinical_data_lq2 <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
    filter(!is.na(celltype_Monocytes), !is.na(celltype_T_cells)) %>%
    select(
      sample_id, pid, timepoint, age, sex,
      clinical_mono = celltype_Monocytes,
      clinical_tcells = celltype_T_cells,
      clinical_nk = celltype_NK_cells,
      clinical_neutro = celltype_Neutrophils
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Myeloid-Lymphoid-Ratio (MLR) als Composite
      clinical_mlr = (clinical_mono + clinical_neutro) / (clinical_tcells + clinical_nk + 0.01)
    )

  message("✓ LQ2 Dataset: ", nrow(clinical_data_lq2), " samples from ",
          n_distinct(clinical_data_lq2$pid), " patients")

  # ============================================================
  # MODELL: Monozyten über Zeit
  # ============================================================

  message("\n⏳ Analysiere Monozyten-Dynamik...")

  clinical_model_lq2_mono <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_mono ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_mono <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_mono, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value)

  message("\n--- MONOCYTES: Coefficients ---")
  print(clinical_coef_lq2_mono, n = Inf)

  # ============================================================
  # MODELL: T-Zellen über Zeit
  # ============================================================

  message("\n⏳ Analysiere T-Zell-Dynamik...")

  clinical_model_lq2_tcells <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_tcells ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_tcells <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_tcells, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value)

  message("\n--- T-CELLS: Coefficients ---")
  print(clinical_coef_lq2_tcells, n = Inf)

  # ============================================================
  # MODELL: Myeloid-Lymphoid-Ratio
  # ============================================================

  message("\n⏳ Analysiere Myeloid-Lymphoid-Ratio...")

  clinical_model_lq2_mlr <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_mlr ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_mlr <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_mlr, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value)

  message("\n--- MYELOID-LYMPHOID-RATIO: Coefficients ---")
  print(clinical_coef_lq2_mlr, n = Inf)

  # ============================================================
  # Effect Sizes
  # ============================================================

  clinical_effect_lq2 <- clinical_data_lq2 %>%
    group_by(timepoint) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mono_mean = mean(clinical_mono, na.rm = TRUE),
      mono_sd = sd(clinical_mono, na.rm = TRUE),
      tcells_mean = mean(clinical_tcells, na.rm = TRUE),
      tcells_sd = sd(clinical_tcells, na.rm = TRUE),
      mlr_mean = mean(clinical_mlr, na.rm = TRUE),
      mlr_sd = sd(clinical_mlr, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  message("\n--- EFFECT SIZES LQ2 ---")
  print(clinical_effect_lq2)

  # ============================================================
  # Visualisierung: Multi-Panel (Mono, T-cells, MLR)
  # ============================================================

  # Panel A: Monozyten
  clinical_plot_lq2_a <- clinical_data_lq2 %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = clinical_mono)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = timepoint), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "red") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "A: Monocyte Dynamics",
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "Monocyte Score (MCP-counter)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  # Panel B: T-Zellen
  clinical_plot_lq2_b <- clinical_data_lq2 %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = clinical_tcells)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = timepoint), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "blue") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "B: T-Cell Dynamics",
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "T-Cell Score (MCP-counter)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  # Panel C: Myeloid-Lymphoid-Ratio
  clinical_plot_lq2_c <- clinical_data_lq2 %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = clinical_mlr)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = timepoint), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "purple") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "purple", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "C: Myeloid-Lymphoid Ratio",
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "MLR (Myeloid / Lymphoid)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  # Kombiniere Panels
  if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(patchwork)
    clinical_plot_lq2_combined <- clinical_plot_lq2_a / clinical_plot_lq2_b / clinical_plot_lq2_c +
      plot_annotation(
        title = "PRIMARY LQ2: Myeloid-Lymphoid Shift (Deconvolution-based)",
        subtitle = sprintf("MCP-counter Cell-Type Scores (n=%d patients)", n_distinct(clinical_data_lq2$pid)),
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14))
      )
  } else {
    # Fallback: Einzelplots nebeneinander
    par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
    print(clinical_plot_lq2_a)
    print(clinical_plot_lq2_b)
    print(clinical_plot_lq2_c)
    par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
    clinical_plot_lq2_combined <- NULL
  }

  if (!is.null(clinical_plot_lq2_combined)) {
    print(clinical_plot_lq2_combined)

    ggsave(
      file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_lq2_myeloid_lymphoid_shift.png"),
      clinical_plot_lq2_combined,
      width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 300
    )
    message("💾 Figure gespeichert: primary_lq2_myeloid_lymphoid_shift.png")
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Speichere Ergebnisse
  # ============================================================

  clinical_results_lq2 <- list(
    mode = "deconvolution",
    model_monocytes = clinical_model_lq2_mono,
    model_tcells = clinical_model_lq2_tcells,
    model_mlr = clinical_model_lq2_mlr,
    coef_monocytes = clinical_coef_lq2_mono,
    coef_tcells = clinical_coef_lq2_tcells,
    coef_mlr = clinical_coef_lq2_mlr,
    effect_sizes = clinical_effect_lq2,
    plot = clinical_plot_lq2_combined
  )

  saveRDS(clinical_results_lq2, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "primary_lq2_results.rds"))
  message("💾 Ergebnisse gespeichert: primary_lq2_results.rds")

} else {

  # ============================================================
  # MODUS 2: Pathway-basiert (Fallback)
  # ============================================================

  message("\n⚠️ LQ2 FALLBACK: Pathway-basierte Analyse")
  message("   → Nutze GSVA-Scores als Surrogate für Zelltyp-Aktivität")

  # Nutze Inflammation (Myeloid-Proxy) und Adaptive (Lymphoid-Proxy)
  clinical_data_lq2_pathway <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
    filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score), !is.na(clinical_adaptive_score)) %>%
    select(
      sample_id, pid, timepoint, age, sex,
      clinical_myeloid_proxy = clinical_inflammation_score,
      clinical_lymphoid_proxy = clinical_adaptive_score
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      clinical_mlr_proxy = clinical_myeloid_proxy - clinical_lymphoid_proxy
    )

  message("✓ LQ2 Pathway Dataset: ", nrow(clinical_data_lq2_pathway), " samples")

  # Modell: Myeloid-Proxy
  clinical_model_lq2_myeloid <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_myeloid_proxy ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2_pathway,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_myeloid <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_myeloid, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed")

  message("\n--- MYELOID-PROXY (Inflammation): Coefficients ---")
  print(clinical_coef_lq2_myeloid, n = Inf)

  # Modell: Lymphoid-Proxy
  clinical_model_lq2_lymphoid <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_lymphoid_proxy ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2_pathway,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_lymphoid <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_lymphoid, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed")

  message("\n--- LYMPHOID-PROXY (Adaptive): Coefficients ---")
  print(clinical_coef_lq2_lymphoid, n = Inf)

  clinical_results_lq2 <- list(
    mode = "pathway",
    model_myeloid = clinical_model_lq2_myeloid,
    model_lymphoid = clinical_model_lq2_lymphoid,
    coef_myeloid = clinical_coef_lq2_myeloid,
    coef_lymphoid = clinical_coef_lq2_lymphoid
  )

  saveRDS(clinical_results_lq2, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "primary_lq2_results.rds"))
  message("💾 Ergebnisse gespeichert (Pathway-Modus): primary_lq2_results.rds")
}

message("\n✓ PRIMARY LQ2 abgeschlossen (Modus: ", clinical_lq2_mode, ")")
```

```{r}
#| label: step9-primary-summary-multiple-testing
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 9.4: PRIMARY SUMMARY & Multiple Testing Correction ===")

# ============================================================
# Ziel: Konsolidiere alle Primary Results, appliziere Holm-Bonferroni
# Entscheidung E4: Holm-Korrektur für 3 Primary-Tests
# ============================================================

message("\n⏳ Konsolidiere Primary Results...")

# ============================================================
# Extrahiere KEY P-VALUES aus allen 3 Primary Analyses
# ============================================================

# Q1: Interaktion timepoint × EF_group (falls gefittet)
if (exists("clinical_coef_q1")) {
  clinical_pval_q1_interaction <- clinical_coef_q1 %>%
    filter(grepl("timepoint.*ef_group", term)) %>%
    pull(p.value)

  # Falls keine Interaktion (nur Haupteffekte): nimm Haupteffekt timepoint
  if (length(clinical_pval_q1_interaction) == 0) {
    clinical_pval_q1_interaction <- clinical_coef_q1 %>%
      filter(term == "timepointV1") %>%
      pull(p.value)
  }

  clinical_pval_q1 <- ifelse(
    length(clinical_pval_q1_interaction) > 0,
    min(clinical_pval_q1_interaction),  # Falls mehrere Interaktions-Terms: nimm min
    NA
  )
} else {
  clinical_pval_q1 <- NA
}

# Q2: Interaktion timepoint × CAD
if (exists("clinical_coef_q2")) {
  clinical_pval_q2_interaction <- clinical_coef_q2 %>%
    filter(grepl("timepoint.*relevant_cad", term)) %>%
    pull(p.value)

  if (length(clinical_pval_q2_interaction) == 0) {
    clinical_pval_q2_interaction <- clinical_coef_q2 %>%
      filter(term == "timepointV2") %>%
      pull(p.value)
  }

  clinical_pval_q2 <- ifelse(
    length(clinical_pval_q2_interaction) > 0,
    min(clinical_pval_q2_interaction),
    NA
  )
} else {
  clinical_pval_q2 <- NA
}

# LQ2: Timepoint-Effekt auf Monozyten ODER MLR
if (exists("clinical_coef_lq2_mono")) {
  clinical_pval_lq2_mono <- clinical_coef_lq2_mono %>%
    filter(grepl("timepoint", term)) %>%
    pull(p.value) %>%
    min()

  clinical_pval_lq2 <- clinical_pval_lq2_mono
} else if (exists("clinical_coef_lq2_myeloid")) {
  clinical_pval_lq2_myeloid <- clinical_coef_lq2_myeloid %>%
    filter(grepl("timepoint", term)) %>%
    pull(p.value) %>%
    min()

  clinical_pval_lq2 <- clinical_pval_lq2_myeloid
} else {
  clinical_pval_lq2 <- NA
}

# ============================================================
# Multiple Testing Correction: Holm-Bonferroni
# ============================================================

clinical_primary_pvalues <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c("Q1_EF_Inflammation", "Q2_CAD_Ribosome", "LQ2_Myeloid_Lymphoid"),
  Description = c(
    "EF group × Inflammation (V1 vs A)",
    "CAD × Ribosome Recovery (V2 vs V1)",
    "Myeloid-Lymphoid Shift (temporal dynamics)"
  ),
  raw_p = c(clinical_pval_q1, clinical_pval_q2, clinical_pval_lq2),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Holm-Korrektur
clinical_primary_pvalues <- clinical_primary_pvalues %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_p)) %>%
  mutate(
    holm_p = p.adjust(raw_p, method = "holm"),
    sig_raw = case_when(
      raw_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      raw_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
      raw_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    sig_holm = case_when(
      holm_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      holm_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
      holm_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

message("\n=== PRIMARY ANALYSES: Multiple Testing Correction (Holm) ===")
print(clinical_primary_pvalues, row.names = FALSE)

# Speichere Summary
write.csv(
  clinical_primary_pvalues,
  file.path(clinical_output_dir, "primary_analyses_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("\n💾 Summary gespeichert: primary_analyses_summary.csv")

# ============================================================
# Interpretation Guide
# ============================================================

message("\n=== INTERPRETATION ===")
message("1. RAW P-VALUES: Unadjusted für multiple comparisons")
message("2. HOLM P-VALUES: Adjustiert für 3 Primary-Tests (konservativ)")
message("3. Berichte BEIDE in Paper:")
message("   - Main Text: Holm-adjusted")
message("   - Supplement: Raw p-values mit Disclosure")

n_sig_raw <- sum(clinical_primary_pvalues$raw_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_sig_holm <- sum(clinical_primary_pvalues$holm_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

message(sprintf(
  "\n✓ SIGNIFIKANTE BEFUNDE: %d/%d (raw), %d/%d (Holm-adjusted)",
  n_sig_raw, nrow(clinical_primary_pvalues),
  n_sig_holm, nrow(clinical_primary_pvalues)
))

message("\n✓ PRIMARY ANALYSES KOMPLETT")
```
